description: A 301 redirect plan for redundant pages: source, destination, reason, Search Console evidence, intent similarity, confidence, risk, required content migration and internal links to update. Detects chains, loops, canonical conflicts and irrelevant destinations. Proposals only: nothing is executed and every redirect needs your approval. Uses your connected Google Search Console (read-only) plus a crawl of the site; the analysis is reused for a day. Never changes your site: redirects are proposals only. Needs an API key from a paid plan.

site.description: Search Console property, for example sc-domain:example.com or https://example.com/. Omit to use the site of your latest Page Intelligence analysis.
